notes.title: Demo build small update 20230123
notes.content:
- fixed the display issue occured in one of the level from redlight street.
- you can now see the currently equipped weapon in "Item Interface". The activated weapon(or weapon slot) is displayed with a yellow column.
- fixed the bug that triggered when switching weapon.
- equipped weapon cannot be disposed now in craft menu.
- the safelock in the Office building Raid level is now respawned daily(in-game).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747371/e14246c7fb7293eb678431326c64b43b6f2342b1.png

notes.title: Demo build small update
notes.content:
- Adjusted the wrong sized background NPC.
- Added some SFX to mini-games.
- Updated one of the kick attack's SFX.
- Changed the text colour when not enough money to purchase an item.
- Fixed pedestrian NPC image tearing issue.
- Playtime can now be recorded and displayed normaly.
- Added a SFX when player move close to savepoint (flower pot).
- Added some temporary NPC(still image) and finished NPC (in front of school gate.)
- Fixed the issue of button misfunction when confirming in loading save data.

notes.title: Demo update, ver 0.2094.220620
notes.content:
Bug fixes:
-	Raid area reset unfunctional caused by sleeping at bedroom is now fixed.
-	Optimized exit trigger area in warehouse Raid stage.
-	The confirming window causing player control invalid, now is fixed.
-	After defeating Ji-yeong (Boss from Warehouse Raid), if you save game before sleeping at bedroom, then loading the save data will cause black screen, is now fixed.

Improvement:
-	In the title screen, if you do have a save data of the game, the default cursor will be located at “Load game”
-      Also added some text for the Chinese localizations.


We will keep improve the demo build while adding more content for the relase version. Thank you all very much for your support!

O.T.K. GAMES

notes.title: Demo update, ver 0.2089.220620
notes.content:
WHAT'S NEW?

Unfortunately the old saves may cause the old issues still be there, so we suggest to start a new save.


 If the map still doesn't show when viewing the maps, then please empty the folder contains all the saves: 
X:\Users\Your user name\AppData\Local\ProjectISS\Saved
 weapon mod now works properly if you start a new save.
 a confirm window added before you go to bed in your room.
 moving stages causing your default weapon changed will not happen again.
 a new visual effect for leveling up skills.
 lowered the difficulties for literature class.
 if there is still screen tearing issue, please activate the V-sync in option->graphic




What to update next?


 Voice over for player character(combat call out and interaction response, full dialogue voice over is planned post-release)
 NPC follower
 More weapons
 Finalized background scene visuals and visual effects.
 More NPCs
 Character condition display.
 And more.


We will keep improve the demo build while adding more content for the relase version. Thank you all very much for your support!

O.T.K. GAMES

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747371/e14246c7fb7293eb678431326c64b43b6f2342b1.png

notes.title: Demo update, ver 0.2070.220612
notes.content:
WHAT’S NEW?


 New NPC (police unit at school area)
 Crafting & Weapon customize feature (not very stable at the moment.)
 New items and accessories.
 Partial UI improvement.
 New soundtracks (but not fully implemented)
 Time forward mechanics fully functional.


The current saves can still be used in the updated build.


We plan to update more content soon within this month (June,2022), here is a list of what will be added:


 Voice over for player character(combat call out and interaction response, full dialogue voice over is planned post-release)
 NPC follower
 More weapons
 Finalized background scene visuals and visual effects.
 More NPCs
 Character condition display.
 And more.


We hope you enjoy the demo, and tell us what you like and dislike about the game. 
Thank you all for your support!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38747371/e14246c7fb7293eb678431326c64b43b6f2342b1.png

O.T.K GAMES
